independent_support.ring16_definition: repository D4 x abstract ring swap

four_a_estimability.eligible_exposure_definition: support-qualified modifiable A_pos choice before the game's first positional tier loss with an observed immediate opponent reply

four_b_state_conditioned_effect.event_definition: immediate opponent reply is the game's first positional tier loss
four_b_state_conditioned_effect.winner_curse_correction: whole-game deterministic two-fold action selection, Jeffreys shrinkage, and ring16-state cluster bootstrap

known_biases.state_overlap: diagnostic only; game and player membership own contamination
known_biases.transport: no inference to product UI, other time controls, or new people

concentration.provenance: player top-1, Gini, and Kish gates inherit F0-H0 v1; remaining descriptive gates were frozen before this screen

estimability.provenance: frozen before state support, reachability, concentration, or effect statistics were computed

independent_support.provenance: inherits the pre-statistic exact-state support floor and supported-decision coverage from F0-H0 v1; applies the same floor to ring16

modifiable_reachability.provenance: inherits the pre-statistic 5 percent modifiable-state and 10 percent supported-game-reach floors from F0-H0 v1

oracle_coverage.missing_or_out_of_domain_policy: abstain and count against coverage; never substitute or impute

product_effect.gate: trigger the stop condition when every corrected transition upper 95 percent bound, or the conservative all-sample supported-guided upper bound, is below 0.01
product_effect.provenance: inherits the one-percentage-point pre-statistic signed product threshold from F0-H0 v1; this is a rejection threshold, not an approval or release threshold
product_effect.unit: absolute probability of an immediate first positional WDL downgrade per eligible source-domain game or exposure
